title: AC Electrical
description: The AC Electrical Committee focuses on the design, implementation, and maintenance of electrical systems in our projects, ensuring safety, efficiency, and innovation.

title: AC Mechanical
description: The AC Mechanical Committee focuses on the design, implementation, and maintenance of mechanical systems in our projects, ensuring safety, efficiency, and innovation.

title: Software Committee
description: The Software Committee focuses on creating and maintaining websites that are user-friendly, visually appealing, and accessible.

title: Digital Marketing Committee
description: The Digital Marketing Committee drives engagement and awareness by developing creative campaigns, managing promotional activities, and leveraging various marketing channels to reach our target audience.

title: OC Committee
description: The OC Committee ensures smooth execution of events by coordinating logistics, managing schedules, and overseeing event operations to ensure everything runs efficiently and effectively.

title: HR Committee
description: The HR Committee focuses on recruitment, training, and development, ensuring that we have a motivated and well-prepared team to achieve our goals and maintain a positive organizational culture.

title: PR Committee
description: The PR Committee manages the organization's public image by building relationships with media, crafting press releases, and handling communications to maintain a positive and professional reputation.
